channel.title: Quotes on Irina Travels
channel.description: Recent content in Quotes on Irina Travels

item.title: Frank Herbert
item.description:
Without new experiences, something inside of us sleeps. The sleeper must awaken.

~ Frank Herbert

item.title: Mary Ritter Beard
item.description:
Certainly, travel is more than the seeing of sights; it is a change that goes on, deep and permanent, in the ideas of living.

~ Mary Ritter Beard

item.title: H. Miller
item.description:
One’s destination is never a place, but a new way of seeing things.

~ H. Miller

item.title: Gilbert K. Chesterton
item.description:
The traveller sees what he sees, the tourist sees what he has come to see.

~ Gilbert K. Chesterton

item.title: Saint Augustine
item.description:
The World is a book, and those who do not travel read only a page.

~ Saint Augustine
